_comment: Ceiling floors re-measured 2026-09-12 under score.py SCORER_VERSION 4 against the pinned corpora with the Prism v0.74.0 candidate. V4 treats answer sites as a set and correctly treats Maven src/test/java and other /test/ paths as neutral; the prior v3 baseline and scorer no longer had the same matching contract. Every floor below is the observed v4 value, not a relaxed threshold. All 13 cases were run; the two previously failing cases returned byte-identical site sets under released Prism v0.73.0 and the candidate. The remaining production extras are BeanDeserializerBase.handlePolymorphic for jackson-deserialize and TransformedListIterator.add/set for commons-collections-transformer-transform; they remain scored as extras, not silently excluded. A run below baseline minus tolerance is a regression. ci_invariants refuses to compare different scorer versions.
